author: sifirelli
quote: Complete disagree to all the optimist ideas. Story is a total crap and the characters are just disasters. None of us players want to play a "be a good boyfriend" simulator. We were searching for to experience the life of a real badass gangster with too many more tools and better graphics/physics. Taketwo made the worst decision of their entire being by keeping the idiots who wrote this scenario in their office.
